commands.label: Expand original snippet using the actual Vim UltiSnips plugin
commands.stderr: Reading viminfo file "${SCRATCH}/753-vmhzp8k5/home/.viminfo" info oldfiles FAILED Writing viminfo file "${SCRATCH}/753-vmhzp8k5/home/.viminfo"

expand.vim.content_utf8:
set nocompatible
set encoding=utf-8
set runtimepath^=${SCRATCH}/tools/SirVer-ultisnips-3.2/source/ultisnips-3.2
set runtimepath^=.
let g:UltiSnipsSnippetDirectories=['case-snippets']
filetype on
runtime plugin/UltiSnips.vim
set filetype=fixture
call setline(1, 'hello')
call cursor(1, 5)
call feedkeys("a\<Tab>\<Esc>", "xt")
call writefile(getline(1, '$'), 'rendered.txt')
qa!
